# L1-QM020-THM3-ROW-SPARSITY

BornRedundancy proves descent compatibility iff each real2x2 row has at most one nonzero entry. This is weaker than an invertible monomial matrix: [[1,0],[2,0]] is row-sparse with rank1. Preserve that counterexample, zero rows and the mixing-row sign witnesses. Output layout: plus2;minus2;difference2;row_sparse;det;invertible_monomial;rank

Supported: Exact phase-sign readouts, row sparsity, determinant, monomial and rank distinctions; universal row interference and a singular sparse control in Lean.

Remaining: Prove the full representation refinement and add injectivity/column conditions before claiming monomial invertibility. No scalar label licenses the stronger claim.
